scope: Real Chromium components with mocked HTTP and real source-input validation; not PostgreSQL persistence, live AI or OCR.
checks: All 16 relevant business/shared module guides render
Sample populates editable form and real server validator receives typed modified facts
Editing a checked fact invalidates the saved preview
Fresh saved member ID flows into real batch assessment request; saved response displayed
Member-matched PDF explicitly prepared then uploaded; actual QUEUED status is not treated as verified
Published workflow receives selected saved member and assessment date
Copilot question scope follows actual saved member and selected module
CSV upload rejects invalid types and preserves false/whole-number facts
Bounded per-member requests display partial completion and refresh saved results after error
Changing the selected member clears prepared document and title
Late response from previous batch does not replace selected batch records
Theme tokens and narrow viewport have no page overflow
Auditor UI exposes saved evidence and prevents intake, assessment, upload and workflow mutation
